result.summary: Replaces the Boost.Test library with a custom in-tree C++ test runner and assertion framework in src/test/util/framework.{h,cpp}. The new framework implements expression decomposition to automatically output operand values upon test assertion failures. It provides backward-compatible BOOST_* macro shims to prevent merge conflicts across existing tests and completely drops Boost.Test from CMake, depends, Guix, and vcpkg.
result.problem: Boost.Test is an external dependency that complicates depends and Guix build maintenance, hinders clang-tidy and IWYU static analysis tooling in test files, and provides inconsistent assertion macros that often omit expression values on failure or fail to compile with custom repository types.
evidence: Author description: 'Replacing Boost.Test as a runner helps us simplify depends and guix as well as use IWYU and clang-tidy within the tests more effectively. It is my opinion that we can also improve the developer experience when writing tests.'

Commit message for 7d0b62c59b notes standard comparison semantics: 'Integers with mixed signs are compared using std::cmp_*, which is a deliberate deviation from boost. This removes potential underflows or overflows similar to #35689.'
Referenced open RFC issue #34666 and long-standing issue #8670 discuss replacing Boost.Test due to signal stack issues and dependency weight.

enables: Gradual migration of test files from BOOST_* compatibility macros to native CHECK and TEST_CASE macros.

result.scope_notes: Over 160 of the 168 files changed are identical single-line header updates performed via a scripted-diff commit. The substantive C++ test framework logic is concentrated in src/test/util/framework.h and src/test/util/framework.cpp (~1,200 lines added).
result.changed_since_previous: No substantial changes in approach or scope since the previous review; the commit stack and Guix/depends cleanups remain essentially the same.
result.card: This pull request removes Boost.Test and introduces an in-tree test runner and assertion library in src/test/util/framework.{h,cpp}. The change eliminates Boost.Test as an external build dependency in depends, Guix, and vcpkg, improves static analysis compatibility, and adds expression decomposition so failing test assertions automatically log evaluated operand values. Backward-compatible BOOST_* macro aliases prevent conflicts with existing and in-flight test code. Over 160 files in the diff are mechanical header replacements executed via a scripted diff.

risk.why: Flaws in assertion evaluation or test execution could lead to false test passes or spurious CI failures, but production node binaries and consensus rules are unaffected.
